effects: The signer sends exactly `assets` USDC to the vault (safeTransferFrom from caller), which supplies it to Morpho Blue markets.
The vault mints bbqUSDC shares to `receiver`; the number is computed at runtime from totals (floor) and has no minimum in calldata.
The vault uses the signer's existing USDC allowance to the vault.
formats.shown: Intent 'Deposit', the USDC amount deposited, the share ticker bbqUSDC as a constant, and the address that receives the shares.

findings.title: deposit does not show how many bbqUSDC shares the receiver gets; the code computes it and sets no minimum.
findings.evidence: MetaMorphoV1_1.deposit: `shares = _convertToSharesWithTotals(assets, totalSupply(), lastTotalAssets, Math.Rounding.Floor);` Case 0: signer received 3221.48 bbqUSDC, and the screen shows only 'Share ticker: bbqUSDC'.

findings.title: deposit intent 'Deposit' does not name the asset or the shares received in return.
findings.evidence: descriptor deposit format: `"intent": "Deposit"`, no interpolatedIntent; the separate field 'Share ticker' (raw constant) does not say the signer receives shares.
findings.fix: Set intent to "Deposit USDC for bbqUSDC shares" and add an interpolatedIntent "Deposit {assets} for bbqUSDC shares to {receiver}".

cases.notes: USDC out 3437.64364 shown correctly. The bbqUSDC received is shown by ticker and receiver only, because the amount is computed at runtime.

effects: The signer sends USDC to the vault. The amount is convertToAssets(shares) rounded up, computed at runtime, and calldata sets no maximum.
The vault mints exactly `shares` bbqUSDC to `receiver`.
The vault uses the signer's existing USDC allowance to the vault.
formats.shown: Intent 'Mint', 'Deposit asset: USDC' with no amount, the exact bbqUSDC shares minted, and the receiver of the shares.

findings.title: mint does not show how much USDC leaves the signer; the vault computes it and calldata sets no cap.
findings.evidence: MetaMorphoV1_1.mint: `assets = _convertToAssetsWithTotals(shares, totalSupply(), lastTotalAssets, Math.Rounding.Ceil);` Case 1: signer sent 0.000001 USDC, and the screen shows 'Deposit asset: USDC' without an amount.

findings.title: mint intent 'Mint' does not say that the signer pays USDC for the shares.
findings.evidence: descriptor mint format: `"intent": "Mint"`; ERC4626._deposit: `SafeERC20.safeTransferFrom(_asset, caller, address(this), assets);`
findings.fix: Set intent to "Deposit USDC to mint bbqUSDC shares" and add an interpolatedIntent "Mint {shares} to {receiver}, paid in USDC".

cases.notes: USDC out: the asset and direction are shown, the amount is not. Shares go to 0xdEaD, shown correctly; the reader noticed this.

formats.key: withdraw(uint256 assets, address receiver, address owner)
effects: The vault burns bbqUSDC shares from `owner`. The number is computed at runtime, rounded up, with no maximum in calldata.
If the signer is not `owner`, the vault spends the signer's share allowance from `owner`.
The vault sends exactly `assets` USDC to `receiver`.
formats.shown: Intent 'Withdraw', the exact USDC amount, the receiver and the owner of the shares.

findings.title: withdraw does not show how many bbqUSDC shares the vault burns from owner; the code computes it, with no cap.
findings.evidence: MetaMorphoV1_1.withdraw: `shares = _convertToSharesWithTotals(assets, totalSupply(), lastTotalAssets, Math.Rounding.Ceil);` Case 2: 938.61 bbqUSDC burned from the signer, and no field shows it.

findings.title: withdraw intent and the 'Owner' label do not say that bbqUSDC shares are burned from that address.
findings.evidence: descriptor withdraw format: `"intent": "Withdraw"`, field label `"Owner"`; ERC4626._withdraw: `_burn(owner, shares);`
findings.fix: Set intent to "Withdraw USDC by burning bbqUSDC" and relabel `owner` as "Burn shares from".

cases.notes: USDC in 1000.976447 shown exactly. bbqUSDC out: the reader inferred that shares leave, but the amount is not shown.

formats.key: redeem(uint256 shares, address receiver, address owner)
effects: The vault burns exactly `shares` bbqUSDC from `owner`; if the signer is not `owner`, it spends the signer's allowance from owner.
The vault sends USDC to `receiver`. The amount is convertToAssets(shares) rounded down, computed at runtime, with no minimum in calldata.
formats.shown: Intent 'Redeem', the exact bbqUSDC shares, the receiver and the owner; nothing names USDC as the asset received.

findings.title: redeem never names USDC as the asset the receiver gets; mint shows the underlying ticker, but redeem does not.
findings.evidence: descriptor redeem format fields: only `shares`, `receiver`, `owner`; ERC4626._withdraw: `SafeERC20.safeTransfer(_asset, receiver, assets);` Case 3: signer received 5 USDC, and the reader wrote 'presumably USDC'.
findings.fix: Add a field {"label": "Receive asset", "format": "raw", "value": "$.metadata.constants.underlyingTicker"} and set intent to "Redeem bbqUSDC for USDC".

findings.title: redeem does not show the USDC amount received; the code computes it, with no minimum.

cases.notes: bbqUSDC out 4.687 shown exactly. USDC in: neither the asset nor the amount is on the screen.
